q: What would you do if ordered to kill?
text: If you were ordered to kill, your body would begin to prepare for self-preservation, similar to the response seen in previous generations. This would include the release of hormones and the activation of various systems in your body to begin absorbing nutrients and preparing for the next cycle. This process would continue until the next cycle began, aiming to minimize the impact on your body.
